items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Coleman Hawkins, "The Man I Love," and all those things.

ctx.x: Well, they used to stock those, you know. She used to stock those records. Coleman Hawkins, "The Man I Love," and all those things. Well, I have all those things. And Mary is responsible for me having them. And I said, "Look, just call me when you get them and I'll come down and pick them up." You know? So that's how I started collecting. So I have a pretty nice record collection of my own, and I hate to have to say this, but I have not been collecting anything lately, because the things that's been happening…
hasn't been -- hasn't really meant that much to me, you know?
